verdict.rationale: a-Shell's own documentation says it ships with Vim and that users can edit files and run syntax checkers via vim-lsp or ALE inside the app, which covers both halves of the story. Other docs confirm users can edit their programs and run them in the app. missing for 10: documentation of how vim-lsp/ALE are installed and which linters or language servers actually run on iOS, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can edit files with a terminal-based editor and run syntax/lint checkers inside the app

citations.quote: a-Shell comes with Vim included. You can edit your files and even run syntax checkers using e.g. vim-lsp or ALE.
Edit your programs and run them inside the app.
